definitions.gloss: chilly, slightly cold, cool enough to feel on the skin
definitions.explanation: A mild degree of cold felt on the skin, typically describing weather or air temperature. Conveys a sensation milder than 寒い (cold) — the kind of chill that makes you want a light jacket.

examples.japanese: {今朝|けさ}は{肌寒|はだざむ}い。
{秋|あき}になると{朝晩|あさばん}は{肌寒|はだざむ}くなる。
examples.english: When autumn comes, mornings and evenings become chilly.

examples.japanese: {肌寒|はだざむ}い{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いていたので、カーディガンを{羽織|はお}った。
examples.english: A chilly breeze was blowing, so I threw on a cardigan.

notes:
READING NOTE:
This word has two readings: {肌寒|はだざむ}い and {肌寒|はださむ}い. Both are correct and widely used. This entry covers the はだざむい reading.

USAGE:
{肌寒|はだざむ}い describes a subtle, skin-level chill — not deep cold, but enough to notice. It is a seasonal word often associated with early autumn or late spring, when daytime is warm but mornings and evenings are cool.

Compared to {寒|さむ}い (cold), {肌寒|はだざむ}い is milder and more specific to the sensation on the skin. Compared to {涼|すず}しい (cool, refreshing), {肌寒|はだざむ}い has a slightly unpleasant nuance — not refreshing, but uncomfortably cool.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肌寒|はだざむ}い{朝|あさ}: a chilly morning
- {肌寒|はだざむ}い{風|かぜ}: a chilly breeze
- {肌寒|はだざむ}い{季節|きせつ}: the chilly season
- {肌寒|はだざむ}く{感|かん}じる: to feel chilly
